editorial.blurb: A lively sports bar serving up crispy wings, rings, and creative sandwiches with attentive service and a fun, energetic atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Request all flats (or all drums) when ordering wings—no upcharge and the kitchen accommodates custom requests seamlessly. Go on weekdays to avoid weekend waits and the need to use the Yelp app to check your spot in line.
